ctx.x: Well Charlie Barnett and he used to come over there by the entertainers when he was in town. And Louis Premon was over there every night. I used to sing Chinatown in China, my version of China. And every night I'd have a different version and Louis was over there trying to pick up on it. You understand me?

I think you recorded Chinatown. Who? Louis. I'll have to dig up. No, I'm talking about Louis Premon. He might have. I'm not sure, but I'll begin. He might have. Well anyway, who was in Alvin Wall's band? Is that Fats Wall? Is that the guy they call Fats?

No. You see, those boys, they were from all out of the East. Well West played with them for a while. And nobody from here, how I got the job is through Victor Spencer. When Victor Spencer was taking so many hands and so, you know, you understand me? I didn't want to come this way. Well I got into Charlie Christian. I liked his style because he played on it. You know, all the styles. That's the guy. You ever heard that record with Lionel Hampton guys? All them kind of numbers like that. Well I wanted to be around…
